status: done, verified. binconf_other015 wins on overall 3-way kappa (0.5303 vs 0.4940) on this clean population, and ties exactly on polarity-only kappa (0.6865 both -- confirmed NOT a duplication bug via row-level check, only 80% raw prediction agreement despite identical kappa value, a real coincidence not an artifact). This is now the most trustworthy individual-model kappa comparison in the project -- supersedes both the stale r7v2_baseline=0.4840 citation and the leaked aleatoric-set numbers. Supports binconf_other015 as the fine-tuning target on both kappa grounds AND the earlier architectural grounds (confidence head, cascade compatibility).
